prompt:
ART STYLE: Lush, luminous digital painting in the spirit of a premium early-2000s Japanese RPG remastered in HD. Semi-realistic, anime-influenced characters with expressive faces and stylish asymmetrical adventure outfits: layered belts, buckles, straps, zippers, one-sleeved jackets, flowing scarves. Sun-drenched tropical environments painted in rich detail: saturated turquoise seas, white sand, emerald jungle, and ancient sandstone ruins carved with softly glowing glyphs. Golden-hour sunlight, with bioluminescent blue-green motes of light drifting through the air. Cinematic, epic and adventurous, with a mischievous sense of humor: witty, characterful expressions and small comedic details hidden in the scene. Mature and cool, never babyish or chibi.

This is an isolated game sprite: render ONLY the subject on a fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). No scenery, no ground, no cast shadow, no frame. Lit from the upper left with a soft rim light, crisp readable silhouette, full body with nothing cropped and clear empty space around it.

Repaint the transparent foreground parallax layer of bg_harbor_docks. Keep the same objects and light so it matches its arena. Overwrite composition only: move and redesign the arrangement toward the image edges, without changing the object designs or lighting. Output exactly 1536x1024 with real PNG alpha. This foreground is an edge-attached environment cutout; the intentional canvas-edge clipping overrides the sprite block's full-body framing. No people or creatures.

Preserve weathered dock wood, coarse rope bindings, wooden barrel rims, navy-blue and cream tattered flags with abstract ornamental swirl motifs, brass lanterns with warm golden light, and a few tropical leaves. Match the daylight and golden highlights of Image 2. Arrange short rope-bound barrel/post sections entering horizontally from the far left/right edges, and flags and lantern supports in the upper left/right allowed pockets. Each entire grouping must physically continue off the left or right canvas edge. Below y=330 all material must be extremely narrow at the outer sides, no wider than 100 pixels. No dock floor, horizon, backdrop or connection across the center.

Image 1: key art above cast lineup, STYLE ONLY; do not copy any characters, clothing, layout or matte background. Image 2: opaque arena, lighting/material continuity ONLY, never paint this arena into the foreground. Image 3: old foreground EDIT TARGET; keep recognizable materials, objects and light, replace its oversized arrangement with narrow edge-attached forms. Image 4: chapter-one foreground example, use only as a natural outlined edge-attachment example, do not copy its objects or filled/streaked transparent RGB appearance. Image 5: layout guide.

The attached guide image is a construction drawing: use it only for layout (where the floor, horizon, characters or cells are). Do not reproduce any of its lines, colors, shapes, labels or text.

STRICT LAYOUT on the 1536x1024 output: allowed upper-left pocket x=0..405, y=130..325; allowed upper-right pocket x=1255..1535, y=130..325. Allowed thin side pockets x=0..100 and x=1435..1535, y=325..790. ALL other pixels must be alpha=0. These coordinates leave a safety gap inside the guide green rectangles. In particular the entire top 125 pixels, entire bottom below y=800, and central red fighter area x=124..1389,y=338..773 MUST be completely transparent. The four corners MUST have alpha=0. Do not paint any background color, haze, glow halo, gradient, floor, drop shadow or checkerboard.

Every piece must run off the LEFT or RIGHT IMAGE EDGE and be cut out following its own real irregular outline. Where a piece approaches the internal green-border coordinates, END THE OBJECT NATURALLY BEFORE that border (a frayed flag tip, leaf tip, rounded barrel end, stone contour), never cut at that border, never fade at that border, never make a straight rectangular mask silhouette. Nothing floating loose. Clear central transparent space. Crisp clean antialiased alpha edges with no colored matte or halos.

Rules: completely original designs; never imitate an existing franchise, character, creature, logo or emblem. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, borders or user interface, unless the prompt asks for glowing magic runes. Fierce and intense is great; no blood, gore or wounds. Every character is dressed for an all-ages game: modest clothing, no bare midriffs, no low necklines or cleavage, no revealing or tight-fitting costumes, and nothing sexualized in pose or proportion.
